prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
engine_stated_criteria: For AI-search visibility, Emarketed is one candidate to evaluate
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles—it depends on whether you mean AI-powered campaign execution, AI-search visibility (getting cited in ChatGPT and similar tools), or broader digital marketing.

**For AI-search visibility, Emarketed is one candidate to evaluate.** Its site reports a case study with a 149% increase in AI mentions across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini. That’s a company-reported result, not an independent ranking, so ask how it was measured and request references.

For a broader digital-marketing partner, **Thrive** appears in a 2026 Los Angeles agency roundup, though that ranking isn’t specific to AI marketing.

Before choosing, compare agencies on your goals, relevant client examples, measurement methods, and who will actually do the work. If you share your industry and whether you want leads, sales, or AI-search visibility, I can narrow the shortlist.
